settings.definition_quote: In each round $t \in [T]$, the learning agent observes a context consisting of a set of $K$ feature vectors ... drawn i.i.d.~over $t$ ... $Y_{t,i} = \mu(X_{t,i}^\top \beta^*) + \epsilon_{t,i}$ ... $\beta^*$ is sparse ... the agent does not know $s_0$.

settings.name_in_paper: K-armed sparse generalized linear contextual bandit
unmapped: Each round the K feature vectors are drawn i.i.d. over time from an unknown joint density p_X (arms may be correlated)
Sparsity index s_0 is unknown to the learner
Relaxed symmetry of context density with constant nu; balanced covariance condition with constant C_X
Learner knows the link function mu
settings.definition_quote: We consider the stochastic generalized linear bandit problem with $K$ arms ... In this section, we extend our regret analysis to the case of $K \geq 3$ arms.

symbols.phi_0: compatibility constant of the theoretical Gram matrix (phi_0^2)

conditions: compatibility condition on theoretical Gram matrix with constant phi_0^2
tuning: lambda_t = lambda_0 sqrt((4 log t + 2 log d)/t)

source.label: thm:GLM-Lasso-regret-bound_CC
source.quote: Suppose $K = 2$ and Assumptions~\ref{assum:feature_param_bounds}-\ref{assum:rho} hold. Let $\lambda_0 = 2 \sigma x_{\max}$. Then the expected cumulative regret of the \textsc{SA~Lasso~Bandit} policy $\pi$ over horizon~$T \geq 1$  is upper-bounded by $4\kappa_1 + \frac{4 \kappa_1 x_{\max} b (\log(2d^2)+1)}{C_0(s_0)^2} + \frac{32 \kappa_1\nu \sigma x_{\max} s_0 \sqrt{  T \log (dT) }}{\kappa_0\phi^2_0}$ where $C_0(s_0) = \min(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{\phi_0^2}{256s_0 \nu x_{\max}^2})$.

results.notes: Regret defined via expected mean differences, so pseudo-regret against per-round best arm. Algorithm does not use T or s_0, so anytime. C_0(s_0) inlined via Min.

conditions: restricted eigenvalue condition on theoretical Gram matrix with constant phi_1^2

source.label: thm:GLM-Lasso-regret-bound_re
source.quote: Suppose $K = 2$ and Assumptions~\ref{assum:feature_param_bounds}, \ref{assum:link_func_bounds}, \ref{assum:rho}, and \ref{assum:re_condition} hold. Then the expected cumulative regret of the \textsc{SA~Lasso~Bandit} policy is  $\mathcal{O}\big( \sqrt{ s_0 T \log (dT)} \big)$.

results.notes: Proof in appendix gives explicit bound 4k1 + 4k1 x_max b(log(2d^2)+1)/C_2^2 + 48 k1 nu sigma x_max sqrt(s0 T log(dT))/(k0 phi_1^2). Theorem 2 does not assume the compatibility condition (Assumption 3), only RE.

bound.expression_latex: 4\kappa_1 + \frac{4 \kappa_1 x_{\max} b (\log(2d^2)+1)}{C_1(s_0)^2} + \frac{64 \kappa_1\nu C_\mathcal{X}\sigma x_{\max} s_0 \sqrt{  T \log (dT) }}{\kappa_0\phi^2_0}

symbols.phi_0: compatibility constant of the theoretical Gram matrix (phi_0^2)

conditions: balanced covariance condition with constant C_X

source.label: thm:GLM-Lasso-regret-bound_CC_K-arm
source.quote: Suppose $K \geq 3$ and Assumptions~\ref{assum:feature_param_bounds}-\ref{assum:rho}, and \ref{assum:balanced_cov} hold. Let $\lambda_0 = 2 \sigma x_{\max}$. Then the expected cumulative regret ... is upper-bounded by $4\kappa_1 + \frac{4 \kappa_1 x_{\max} b (\log(2d^2)+1)}{C_1(s_0)^2} + \frac{64 \kappa_1\nu C_\mathcal{X}\sigma x_{\max} s_0 \sqrt{  T \log (dT) }}{\kappa_0\phi^2_0}$ where $C_1(s_0) = \min(\frac{1}{2}, \frac{\phi_0^2}{256s_0 \nu C_\mathcal{X} x_{\max}^2})$.

results.notes: C_X may depend on K (up to binom(K-1, ceil((K-1)/2)) for arbitrary independent arms, O(1) for Gaussian/uniform-sphere per Proposition 1).
